summary:
Sunstorm Outpost is a 3D hard-sci-fi Martian survival and engineering simulation built in Godot 4.3 for web browsers. Players manage a remote expedition across distinct Martian landing zones—Jezero Crater Delta, Hellas Planitia Basin, and Olympus Mons Caldera—to survive 14 Martian Sols before executing a physics-driven orbital ascent.

The game directly addresses the challenge of sustaining human life and in-situ resource utilization (ISRU) on Mars under hazardous space weather conditions. Players deploy rovers to harvest water ice, basalt, and hematite from impact craters, refine methane/LOX propellant, erect sintered regolith sandbag berms against dust storms, and perform multi-step mechanical and electrical repairs guided by NASA DONKI solar flare telemetry. On Sol 14, players face a high-stakes "Mass-to-Orbit" dilemma, balancing collected science payloads against fuel reserves for liftoff.

By translating complex aerospace engineering, radiation shielding, and propellant economics into an interactive strategy experience, Sunstorm Outpost bridges scientific accuracy with accessible gameplay—demonstrating the real logistical trade-offs humanity must solve to live and work on the Red Planet.
details:
Sunstorm Outpost is a 3D hard-sci-fi Martian survival and engineering strategy simulation set across a 300m x 300m Martian terrain. Players select one of three distinct Martian landing zones—Jezero Crater Delta, Hellas Planitia Basin, or Olympus Mons Caldera Rim—and manage a three-astronaut expedition and a 6-wheeled rover across 14 Martian Sols.

The core gameplay loop blends real-time strategy (RTS) resource management with hands-on aerospace engineering:

Exploration & ISRU Mining: Players drive the rover into procedural, rock-rimmed impact craters to harvest Basalt (Regolith), Hematite (Refined Alloy), and Permafrost Ice Veins (Water Ice), while using Lidar pings to locate and salvage derelict rovers and historical crash sites (Viking, Heat Shield, and Probe wrecks).

Base Building & Storm Defense: Players deploy sun-tracking Solar Arrays, Battery Banks, MOXIE O2/propellant generators, and modular Sintered Regolith Sandbag berms that physically shield downwind structures from dust accumulation and storm damage.

Tactile Maintenance & Crew Survival: Guided by NASA DONKI-inspired solar flare alerts, players execute multi-step diagnostic repair mini-games (star-pattern torque calibration, electrostatic solar decontamination, and main breaker isolation) where botched repairs cause lasting hardware penalties. Injured or irradiated astronauts must be ordered inside the Pressurized Outpost HQ med-bay to recover—or face permanent death.

Sol 14 Mass-to-Orbit Finale: Surviving until Sol 14 unlocks the Mars Ascent Vehicle (MAV) Payload Manifest, where players balance the mass (kg) of collected science samples and salvaged chipsets against stored methane/LOX rocket fuel before manually throttling their lander into orbit.

Tools, Languages, Hardware & Software Used -

Game Engine & Programming: Godot Engine 4.3+ using GDScript, configured with the Compatibility renderer and single-threaded HTML5/WebAssembly export for zero-install browser play.

3D Modeling & Asset Pipeline: Custom low-poly hard-sci-fi 3D assets (Lander, Outpost HQ, Battery Capacitor Racks, Sintered Gabion Walls, Ore Nodes, and Crash Wrecks) modeled in Blender (.glb), paired with Kenney Space Kit assets and an automated AABB bounding-box scale normalizer.

Shaders & VFX: Custom Godot spatial and canvas shaders for progressive regolith dust sedimentation, structural scorch/damage blending, expanding Lidar sonar rings, and upper-atmosphere Martian proton auroras during solar storms.

Scientific Data: Modeled around NASA MOLA Martian topography, NASA DONKI space weather flare telemetry, and NASA OSDR biological/radiation parameters (with offline JSON fallbacks for browser reliability).

Creativity, Key Factors & Intended Impact -

Creativity: Rather than relying on generic abstract menus, Sunstorm Outpost fuses the edge-anchored RTS command clarity of Age of Empires IV with the physical aerospace instrumentation and orbital physics feel of Kerbal Space Program. Every mechanic—from rotating solar panels tracking the Sol clock to visible Martian proton auroras and live-wire arc flashes—turns abstract survival stats into tangible engineering decisions.

Factors Considered: We prioritized browser accessibility (optimizing triangle counts, draw calls, and single-threaded WebGL compatibility so judges and players can run the 3D simulation smoothly in any browser), risk-reward strategic pacing (forcing players to weigh heavy science cargo against rocket fuel thresholds), and clarity of onboarding via an interactive Flight Director tutorial and pre-mission biome risk/reward briefings.

Intended Impact: Sunstorm Outpost makes the real-world engineering challenges of human Mars exploration—radiation protection, dust mitigation, in-situ propellant production, and mass-to-orbit economics—engaging, intuitive, and memorable for students, space enthusiasts, and educators alike.
